Package theknife.obj.user

Class Customer

java.lang.Object
theknife.obj.user.User
theknife.obj.user.Customer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Customer extends User
Represents a customer user in the system. A customer is a type of User that has a list of favorite restaurants.

This class extends the User class and adds a list of favorite restaurants, allowing the customer to store and manage their preferences.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)
